verdict.rationale: FireHydrant documents a public API with token auth, full UI parity, and an OpenAPI document published via its MCP repo. Nothing in the evidence pack describes API versioning or a deprecation or sunset policy. API versioning is a fair axis for a SaaS platform, so the lack of evidence makes this "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
